comment: Declares an upstream context library to vlurp into this OKF bundle. vlurp (https://github.com/indexzero/vlurp) fetches text from GitHub, pins it to a commit, and hashes every file; we mirror that contract. The `sha256` pins are the provenance anchor: whether the bytes arrive from the vlurp binary or the committed offline fixture, they must hash to these values, so the import is byte-deterministic and drift is detectable.
